text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Σουσακιμ βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς θησαυροὺς τοὺς ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου καὶ τοὺς θησαυροὺς τοὺς ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ βασιλέως τὰ πάντα ἔλαβεν καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς θυρεοὺς τοὺς χρυσοῦς οὓς ἐποίησεν Σαλωμων

text_en: instead of which the king made brazen ones, and delivered them to the captains of the shieldbearers, who guarded the entrance of the palace.
text_la: pro quibus fecit rex æneos, et tradidit illos principibus scutariorum, qui custodiebant vestibulum palatii.
text_pt: E fez o rei Roboão em lugar deles escudos de cobre, e os entregou na mão dos chefes da guarda, que guardavam a porta da casa do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Ροβοαμ θυρεοὺς χαλκοῦς ἀντ' αὐτῶν καὶ κατέστησεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν Σουσακιμ ἄρχοντας παρατρεχόντων τοὺς φυλάσσοντας τὸν πυλῶνα τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And when the king entered into the house of the Lord , the shieldbearers came and took them, and brought them back again to their armoury.
text_la: Cumque introiret rex domum Domini, veniebant scutarii et tollebant eos, iterumque referebant eos ad armamentarium suum.
text_pt: E todas as vezes que o rei entrava na casa do Senhor, vinham os da guarda, e os levavam; depois tornavam a pô-los na câmara da guarda.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἰσελθεῖν τὸν βασιλέα εἰς οἶκον κυρίου εἰσεπορεύοντο οἱ φυλάσσοντες καὶ οἱ παρατρέχοντες καὶ οἱ ἐπιστρέφοντες εἰς ἀπάντησιν τῶν παρατρεχόντων

text_en: But yet because they were humbled , the wrath of the Lord turned away from them, and they were not utterly destroyed: for even in Juda there were found good works.
text_la: Verumtamen quia humiliati sunt, aversa est ab eis ira Domini, nec deleti sunt penitus : siquidem et in Juda inventa sunt opera bona.
text_pt: E humilhando-se ele, a ira do Senhor se desviou dele, para que não o destruísse de todo; porque em Judá ainda havia boas coisas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἐντραπῆναι αὐτὸν ἀπεστράφη ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ὀργὴ κυρίου καὶ οὐκ εἰς καταφθορὰν εἰς τέλος καὶ γὰρ ἐν Ιουδα ἦσαν λόγοι ἀγαθοί

text_en: King Roboam therefore was strengthened in Jerusalem , and reigned: he was one and forty years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Jerusalem , the city which the Lord chose out of all the tribes of Israel , to establish his name there: and the name of his mother was Naama an Ammonitess .
text_la: Confortatus est ergo rex Roboam in Jerusalem, atque regnavit : quadraginta autem et unius anni erat cum regnare cœpisset, et decem et septem annis regnavit in Jerusalem, urbe quam elegit Dominus ut confirmaret nomen suum ibi, de cunctis tribubus Israël : nomen autem matris ejus Naama Ammanitis.
text_pt: Fortificou-se, pois, o rei Roboão em Jerusalém, e reinou; porque Roboão era da idade de quarenta e um anos, quando começou a reinar; e reinou dezessete anos em Jerusalém, a cidade que o Senhor escolheu, dentre todas as tribos de Israel, para pôr ali o seu nome; e era o nome de sua mãe Naamá, amonita.
text_el: καὶ κατίσχυσεν Ροβοαμ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν καὶ τεσσαράκοντα καὶ ἑνὸς ἐτῶν Ροβοαμ ἐν τῷ βασιλεῦσαι αὐτὸν καὶ ἑπτακαίδεκα ἔτη ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐν τῇ πόλει ᾗ ἐξελέξατο κύριος ἐπονομάσαι τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ ἐκ πασῶν φυλῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ καὶ ὄνομα τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ Νοομμα ἡ Αμμανῖτις

text_en: But he did evil , and did not prepare his heart to seek the Lord .
text_la: Fecit autem malum, et non præparavit cor suum ut quæreret Dominum.
text_pt: E fez o que era mau; porquanto não preparou o seu coração para buscar ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πονηρόν ὅτι οὐ κατεύθυνεν τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ ἐκζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον

text_en: Now the acts of Roboam first and last are written in the books of Semeias the prophet , and of Addo the seer, and diligently recorded: and there was war between Roboam and Jeroboam all their days.
text_la: Opera vero Roboam prima et novissima scripta sunt in libris Semeiæ prophetæ, et Addo videntis, et diligenter exposita : pugnaveruntque adversum se Roboam et Jeroboam cunctis diebus.
text_pt: Os atos, pois, de Roboão, assim os primeiros, como os últimos, porventura não estão escritos nos livros de Semaías, o profeta, e de Ido, o vidente, na relação das genealogias? E houve guerras entre Roboão e Jeroboão em todos os seus dias.
text_el: καὶ λόγοι Ροβοαμ οἱ πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ ἔσχατοι οὐκ ἰδοὺ γεγραμμένοι ἐν τοῖς λόγοις Σαμαια τοῦ προφήτου καὶ Αδδω τοῦ ὁρῶντος καὶ πράξεις αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπολέμει Ροβοαμ τὸν Ιεροβοαμ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: And Roboam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David. And Abia his son reigned in his stead.
text_la: Et dormivit Roboam cum patribus suis, sepultusque est in civitate David : et regnavit Abia filius ejus pro eo.
text_pt: E Roboão dormiu com seus pais, e foi sepultado na cidade de Davi; e Abias, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Ροβοαμ καὶ ἐτάφη μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Αβια υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: In the eighteenth year of King Jeroboam , Abia reigned over Juda .
text_la: Anno octavodecimo regis Jeroboam, regnavit Abia super Judam.
text_pt: No ano décimo oitavo do rei Jeroboão, Abias começou a reinar sobre Judá.
text_el: ἐν τῷ ὀκτωκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας Ιεροβοαμ ἐβασίλευσεν Αβια ἐπὶ Ιουδαν

text_en: Three years he reigned in Jerusalem , and his mother's name was Michaia, the daughter of Uriel of Gabaa: and there was war between Abia and Jeroboam .
text_la: Tribus annis regnavit in Jerusalem, nomenque matris ejus Michaia filia Uriel de Gabaa : et erat bellum inter Abiam et Jeroboam.
text_pt: Três anos reinou em Jerusalém; e era o nome de sua mãe Micaía, filha de Uriel de Gibeá; e houve guerra entre Abias e Jeroboão.
text_el: ἔτη τρία ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ Μααχα θυγάτηρ Ουριηλ ἀπὸ Γαβαων καὶ πόλεμος ἦν ἀνὰ μέσον Αβια καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Ιεροβοαμ

text_en: And when Abia had begun battle, and had with him four hundred thousand most valiant and chosen men , Jeroboam put his army in array against him, eight hundred thousand men , who were also chosen and most valiant for war .
text_la: Cumque iniisset Abia certamen, et haberet bellicosissimos viros, et electorum quadringenta millia : Jeroboam instruxit econtra aciem octingenta millia virorum, qui et ipsi electi erant, et ad bella fortissimi.
text_pt: E Abias ordenou a peleja com um exército de valentes guerreiros, quatrocentos mil homens escolhidos; e Jeroboão dispôs contra ele a batalha com oitocentos mil homens escolhidos, todos homens corajosos.
text_el: καὶ παρετάξατο Αβια τὸν πόλεμον ἐν δυνάμει πολεμισταῖς δυνάμεως τετρακοσίαις χιλιάσιν ἀνδρῶν δυνατῶν καὶ Ιεροβοαμ παρετάξατο πρὸς αὐτὸν πόλεμον ἐν ὀκτακοσίαις χιλιάσιν δυνατοὶ πολεμισταὶ δυνάμεως

text_en: And Abia stood upon mount Semeron, which was in Ephraim, and said: Hear me, O Jeroboam , and all Israel :
text_la: Stetit ergo Abia super montem Semeron, qui erat in Ephraim, et ait : Audi, Jeroboam, et omnis Israël.
text_pt: E pôs-se Abias em pé em cima do monte de Zemaraim, que está na montanha de Efraim, e disse: Ouvi-me, Jeroboão e todo o Israel:
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Αβια ἀπὸ τοῦ ὄρους Σομορων ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ εἶπεν ἀκούσατε Ιεροβοαμ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ

text_en: Do you not know that the Lord God of Israel gave to David the kingdom over Israel for ever, to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt ?
text_la: Num ignoratis quod Dominus Deus Israël dederit regnum David super Israël in sempiternum, ipsi et filiis ejus in pactum salis?
text_pt: Porventura não vos convém saber que o Senhor Deus de Israel deu para sempre a Davi a soberania sobre Israel, a ele e a seus filhos, por uma aliança de sal?
text_el: οὐχ ὑμῖν γνῶναι ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἔδωκεν βασιλείαν ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα τῷ Δαυιδ καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ διαθήκην ἁλός

text_en: And Jeroboam the son of Nabat, the servant of Solomon the son of David , rose up: and rebelled against his lord.
text_la: Et surrexit Jeroboam filius Nabat, servus Salomonis filii David, et rebellavit contra dominum suum.
text_pt: Contudo levantou-se Jeroboão, filho de Nebate, servo de Salomão, filho de Davi, e se rebelou contra seu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ιεροβοαμ ὁ τοῦ Ναβατ ὁ παῖς Σαλωμων τοῦ Δαυιδ καὶ ἀπέστη ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And there were gathered to him vain men , and children of Belial : and they prevailed against Roboam the son of Solomon : for Roboam was unexperienced, and of a fearful heart, and could not resist them.
text_la: Congregatique sunt ad eum viri vanissimi, et filii Belial, et prævaluerunt contra Roboam filium Salomonis : porro Roboam erat rudis, et corde pavido, nec potuit resistere eis.
text_pt: E ajuntaram-se a ele homens vadios, filhos de Belial; e fortificaram-se contra Roboão, filho de Salomão, sendo Roboão ainda jovem, e terno de coração, e não lhes podia resistir.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἄνδρες λοιμοὶ υἱοὶ παράνομοι καὶ ἀντέστη πρὸς Ροβοαμ τὸν τοῦ Σαλωμων καὶ Ροβοαμ ἦν νεώτερος καὶ δειλὸς τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ οὐκ ἀντέστη κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And now you say that you are able to withstand the kingdom of the Lord , which he possesses by the sons of David , and you have a great multitude of people, and golden calves, which Jeroboam has made you for gods.
text_la: Nunc ergo vos dicitis quod resistere possitis regno Domini, quod possidet per filios David, habetisque grandem populi multitudinem, atque vitulos aureos quos fecit vobis Jeroboam in deos.
text_pt: E agora julgais que podeis resistir ao reino do Senhor, que está na mão dos filhos de Davi, visto que sois uma grande multidão, e tendes convosco os bezerros de ouro que Jeroboão vos fez para deuses.
text_el: καὶ νῦν λέγετε ὑμεῖς ἀντιστῆναι κατὰ πρόσωπον βασιλείας κυρίου διὰ χειρὸς υἱῶν Δαυιδ καὶ ὑμεῖς πλῆθος πολύ καὶ μεθ' ὑμῶν μόσχοι χρυσοῖ οὓς ἐποίησεν ὑμῖν Ιεροβοαμ εἰς θεούς

text_en: And you have cast out the priests of the Lord , the sons of Aaron , and the Levites : and you have made you priests , like all the nations of the earth: whosoever comes and consecrates his hand with a bullock of the herd, and with seven rams, is made a priest of those who are no gods.
text_la: Et ejecistis sacerdotes Domini, filios Aaron, atque Levitas, et fecistis vobis sacerdotes sicut omnes populi terrarum : quicumque venerit, et initiaverit manum suam in tauro de bobus, et in arietibus septem, fit sacerdos eorum qui non sunt dii.
text_pt: Não lançastes vós fora os sacerdotes do Senhor, os filhos de Arão, e os levitas, e não fizestes para vós sacerdotes, como os povos das outras terras? Qualquer que vem a consagrar-se com um novilho e sete carneiros logo se faz sacerdote daqueles que não são deuses.
text_el: ἦ οὐκ ἐξεβάλετε τοὺς ἱερεῖς κυρίου τοὺς υἱοὺς Ααρων καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας καὶ ἐποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς ἱερεῖς ἐκ τοῦ λαοῦ τῆς γῆς πᾶς ὁ προσπορευόμενος πληρῶσαι τὰς χεῖρας ἐν μόσχῳ ἐκ βοῶν καὶ κριοῖς ἑπτὰ καὶ ἐγίνετο εἰς ἱερέα τῷ μὴ ὄντι θεῷ

text_en: But the Lord is our God , whom we forsake not, and the priests who minister to the Lord are the sons of Aaron , and the Levites are in their order.
text_la: Noster autem Dominus, Deus est, quem non relinquimus, sacerdotesque ministrant Domino, de filiis Aaron, et Levitæ sunt in ordine suo:
text_pt: Porém, quanto a nós, o Senhor é nosso Deus, e nunca o deixamos; e os sacerdotes que ministram ao Senhor são filhos de Arão, e os levitas se ocupam na sua obra.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς κύριον τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐγκατελίπομεν καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ λειτουργοῦσιν τῷ κυρίῳ οἱ υἱοὶ Ααρων καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἐν ταῖς ἐφημερίαις αὐτῶν

text_en: And they offer holocausts to the Lord , every day, morning and evening, and incense made according to the ordinance of the law, and the loaves are set forth on a most clean table, and there is with us the golden candlestick, and the lamps thereof, to be lighted always in the evening: for we keep the precepts of the Lord our God , whom you have forsaken.
text_la: holocausta quoque offerunt Domino per singulos dies mane et vespere, et thymiama juxta legis præcepta confectum, et proponuntur panes in mensa mundissima, estque apud nos candelabrum aureum, et lucernæ ejus, ut accendantur semper ad vesperam : nos quippe custodimus præcepta Domini Dei nostri, quem vos reliquistis.
text_pt: E queimam ao Senhor cada manhã e cada tarde holocaustos, incenso aromático, com os pães da proposição sobre a mesa pura, e o castiçal de ouro, e as suas lâmpadas para se acenderem cada tarde, porque nós temos cuidado do serviço do Senhor nosso Deus; porém vós o deixastes.
text_el: θυμιῶσιν τῷ κυρίῳ ὁλοκαυτώματα πρωὶ καὶ δείλης καὶ θυμίαμα συνθέσεως καὶ προθέσεις ἄρτων ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης τῆς καθαρᾶς καὶ ἡ λυχνία ἡ χρυσῆ καὶ οἱ λυχνοὶ τῆς καύσεως ἀνάψαι δείλης ὅτι φυλάσσομεν ἡμεῖς τὰς φυλακὰς κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐγκατελίπετε αὐτόν

text_en: Therefore God is the leader in our army, and his priests who sound with trumpets, and resound against you: O children of Israel , fight not against the Lord the God of your fathers, for it is not good for you.
text_la: Ergo in exercitu nostro dux Deus est, et sacerdotes ejus, qui clangunt tubis, et resonant contra vos : filii Israël, nolite pugnare contra Dominum Deum patrum vestrorum, quia non vobis expedit.
text_pt: E eis que Deus está conosco, à nossa frente, como também os seus sacerdotes, tocando com as trombetas, para dar alarme contra vós. Ó filhos de Israel, não pelejeis contra o Senhor Deus de vossos pais; porque não prosperareis.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ μεθ' ἡμῶν ἐν ἀρχῇ κύριος καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ σάλπιγγες τῆς σημασίας τοῦ σημαίνειν ἐφ' ὑμᾶς οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ πολεμήσετε πρὸς κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ὅτι οὐκ εὐοδωθήσεται ὑμῖν

text_en: While he spoke these things, Jeroboam caused an ambushment to come about behind him. And while he stood facing the enemies, he encompassed Juda , who perceived it not, with his army.
text_la: Hæc illo loquente, Jeroboam retro moliebatur insidias. Cumque ex adverso hostium staret, ignorantem Judam suo ambiebat exercitu.
text_pt: Mas Jeroboão armou uma emboscada, para dar sobre eles pela retaguarda; de maneira que estavam em frente de Judá e a emboscada por detrás deles.
text_el: καὶ Ιεροβοαμ ἀπέστρεψεν τὸ ἔνεδρον ἐλθεῖν αὐτῶν ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν καὶ ἐγένετο ἔμπροσθεν Ιουδα καὶ τὸ ἔνεδρον ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν

text_en: And when Juda looked back, they saw the battle coming upon them both before and behind, and they cried to the Lord : and the priests began to sound with the trumpets.
text_la: Respiciensque Judas, vidit instare bellum ex adverso et post tergum, et clamavit ad Dominum, ac sacerdotes tubis canere cœperunt.
text_pt: Então Judá olhou, e eis que tinham que pelejar por diante e por detrás; então clamaram ao Senhor; e os sacerdotes tocaram as trombetas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ιουδας καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτοῖς ὁ πόλεμος ἐκ τῶν ἔμπροσθεν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ὄπισθεν καὶ ἐβόησαν πρὸς κύριον καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐσάλπισαν ταῖς σάλπιγξιν

text_en: And all the men of Juda shouted: and behold when they shouted, God terrified Jeroboam , and all Israel that stood against Abia and Juda .
text_la: Omnesque viri Juda vociferati sunt : et ecce illis clamantibus, perterruit Deus Jeroboam, et omnem Israël qui stabat ex adverso Abia et Juda.
text_pt: E os homens de Judá gritaram; e sucedeu que, gritando os homens de Judá, Deus feriu a Jeroboão e a todo o Israel diante de Abias e de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησαν ἄνδρες Ιουδα καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ βοᾶν ἄνδρας Ιουδα καὶ κύριος ἐπάταξεν τὸν Ιεροβοαμ καὶ τὸν Ισραηλ ἐναντίον Αβια καὶ Ιουδα

text_en: And the children of Israel fled before Juda , and the Lord delivered them into their hand.
text_la: Fugeruntque filii Israël Judam, et tradidit eos Deus in manu eorum.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel fugiram de diante de Judá; e Deus os entregou na sua mão.
text_el: καὶ ἔφυγον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ προσώπου Ιουδα καὶ παρέδωκεν αὐτοὺς κύριος εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν

text_en: And Abia and his people slew them with a great slaughter, and there fell wounded of Israel five hundred thousand valiant men .
text_la: Percussit ergo eos Abia et populus ejus plaga magna : et corruerunt vulnerati ex Israël quingenta millia virorum fortium.
text_pt: De maneira que Abias e o seu povo fizeram grande matança entre eles; porque caíram feridos de Israel quinhentos mil homens escolhidos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν ἐν αὐτοῖς Αβια καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ πληγὴν μεγάλην καὶ ἔπεσον τραυματίαι ἀπὸ Ισραηλ πεντακόσιαι χιλιάδες ἄνδρες δυνατοί

text_en: And the children of Israel were brought down, at that time, and the children of Juda were exceedingly strengthened, because they had trusted in the Lord the God of their fathers.
text_la: Humiliatique sunt filii Israël in tempore illo, et vehementissime confortati filii Juda, eo quod sperassent in Domino Deo patrum suorum.
text_pt: E foram humilhados os filhos de Israel naquele tempo; e os filhos de Judá prevaleceram, porque confiaram no Senhor Deus de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ ἐταπεινώθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ κατίσχυσαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ιουδα ὅτι ἤλπισαν ἐπὶ κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν

text_en: And Abia pursued after Jeroboam , and took cities from him, Bethel and her daughters, and Jesana with her daughters, Ephron also and her daughters.
text_la: Persecutus est autem Abia fugientem Jeroboam, et cepit civitates ejus, Bethel et filias ejus, et Jesana cum filiabus suis, Ephron quoque et filias ejus:
text_pt: E Abias perseguiu Jeroboão; e tomou-lhe a Betel com os lugares da sua jurisdição, e a Jesana com os lugares da sua jurisdição, e a Efrom com os lugares da sua jurisdição.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν Αβια ὀπίσω Ιεροβοαμ καὶ προκατελάβετο παρ' αὐτοῦ πόλεις τὴν Βαιθηλ καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Ισανα καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς καὶ τὴν Εφρων καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς

text_en: And Jeroboam was not able to resist any more, in the days of Abia: and the Lord struck him, and he died.
text_la: nec valuit ultra resistere Jeroboam in diebus Abia : quem percussit Dominus, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E Jeroboão não recobrou mais o seu poder nos dias de Abias; porém o Senhor o feriu, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἔσχεν ἰσχὺν Ιεροβοαμ ἔτι πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας Αβια καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτὸν κύριος καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν

text_en: But Abia, being strengthened in his kingdom, took fourteen wives: and begot two and twenty sons, and sixteen daughters.
text_la: Igitur Abia, confortato imperio suo, accepit uxores quatuordecim : procreavitque viginti duos filios, et sedecim filias.
text_pt: Abias, porém, se fortificou, e tomou para si catorze mulheres, e gerou vinte e dois filhos e dezesseis filhas.
text_el: καὶ κατίσχυσεν Αβια καὶ ἔλαβεν ἑαυτῷ γυναῖκας δέκα τέσσαρας καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς εἴκοσι δύο καὶ θυγατέρας δέκα ἕξ

text_en: And the rest of the acts of Abia, and of his ways and works, are written diligently in the book of Addo the prophet .
text_la: Reliqua autem sermonum Abia, viarumque et operum ejus, scripta sunt diligentissime in libro Addo prophetæ.
text_pt: Os demais atos de Abias, tanto os seus caminhos como as suas palavras, estão escritos na história do profeta Ido.
text_el: καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ λόγοι Αβια καὶ αἱ πράξεις αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ γεγραμμένοι ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ τοῦ προφήτου Αδδω

text_en: And Abia slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David: an Asa his son reigned in his stead: in his days the land was quiet ten years.
text_la: Dormivit autem Abia cum patribus suis, et sepelierunt eum in civitate David : regnavitque Asa filius ejus pro eo, in cujus diebus quievit terra annis decem.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αβια μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ασα υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις Ασα ἡσύχασεν ἡ γῆ Ιουδα ἔτη δέκα

text_en: And Asa did that which was good and pleasing in the sight of his God , and he destroyed the altars of foreign worship, and the high places.
text_la: Fecit autem Asa quod bonum et placitum erat in conspectu Dei sui, et subvertit altaria peregrini cultus, et excelsa.
text_pt: E Abias dormiu com seus pais, e o sepultaram na cidade de Davi, e Asa, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar; nos seus dias esteve a terra em paz dez anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ καλὸν καὶ τὸ εὐθὲς ἐνώπιον κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And broke the statues, and cut down the groves.
text_la: Et confregit statuas, lucosque succidit:
text_pt: E Asa fez o que era bom e reto aos olhos do Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστησεν τὰ θυσιαστήρια τῶν ἀλλοτρίων καὶ τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ συνέτριψεν τὰς στήλας καὶ ἐξέκοψεν τὰ ἄλση

text_en: And he commanded Juda to seek the Lord the God of their fathers, and to do the law, and all the commandments.
text_la: et præcepit Judæ ut quæreret Dominum Deum patrum suorum, et faceret legem, et universa mandata:
text_pt: Porque tirou os altares dos deuses estranhos, e os altos; e quebrou as imagens, e cortou os bosques.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιουδα ἐκζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν καὶ ποιῆσαι τὸν νόμον καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς

text_en: And he took away out of all the cities of Juda the altars , and temples, and reigned in peace.
text_la: et abstulit de cunctis urbibus Juda aras et fana, et regnavit in pace.
text_pt: E mandou a Judá que buscasse ao Senhor Deus de seus pais, e que observasse a lei e o mandamento.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστησεν ἀπὸ πασῶν τῶν πόλεων Ιουδα τὰ θυσιαστήρια καὶ τὰ εἴδωλα καὶ εἰρήνευσεν

text_en: He built also strong cities in Juda , for he was quiet, and there had no wars risen in his time, the Lord giving peace.
text_la: Ædificavit quoque urbes munitas in Juda, quia quietus erat, et nulla temporibus ejus bella surrexerant, pacem Domino largiente.
text_pt: Também tirou de todas as cidades de Judá os altos e as imagens; e sob ele o reino esteve em paz.
text_el: πόλεις τειχήρεις ἐν γῇ Ιουδα ὅτι εἰρήνευσεν ἡ γῆ καὶ οὐκ ἦν αὐτῷ πόλεμος ἐν τοῖς ἔτεσιν τούτοις ὅτι κατέπαυσεν αὐτῷ κύριος

text_en: And he said to Juda : Let us build these cities, and compass them with walls, and fortify them with towers, and gates, and bars, while all is quiet from wars, because we have sought the Lord the God of our fathers, and he has given us peace round about. So they built, and there was no hinderance in building.
text_la: Dixit autem Judæ : Ædificemus civitates istas, et vallemus muris, et roboremus turribus, et portis, et seris, donec a bellis quieta sunt omnia, eo quod quæsierimus Dominum Deum patrum nostrorum, et dederit nobis pacem per gyrum. Ædificaverunt igitur, et nullum in exstruendo impedimentum fuit.
text_pt: E edificou cidades fortificadas em Judá; porque a terra estava quieta, e não havia guerra contra ele naqueles anos; porquanto o Senhor lhe dera repouso.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιουδα οἰκοδομήσωμεν τὰς πόλεις ταύτας καὶ ποιήσωμεν τείχη καὶ πύργους καὶ πύλας καὶ μοχλοὺς ἐν ᾧ τῆς γῆς κυριεύσομεν ὅτι καθὼς ἐξεζητήσαμεν κύριον θεὸν ἡμῶν ἐξεζήτησεν ἡμᾶς καὶ κατέπαυσεν ἡμᾶς κυκλόθεν καὶ εὐόδωσεν ἡμῖν

text_en: And Asa had in his army of men that bore shields and spears of Juda three hundred thousand, and of Benjamin that bore shields and drew bows, two hundred and eighty thousand, all these were most valiant men .
text_la: Habuit autem Asa in exercitu suo portantium scuta et hastas de Juda trecenta millia, de Benjamin vero scutariorum et sagittariorum ducenta octoginta millia : omnes isti viri fortissimi.
text_pt: Disse, pois, a Judá: Edifiquemos estas cidades, e cerquemo-las de muros e torres, portas e ferrolhos, enquanto a terra ainda é nossa, pois buscamos ao Senhor nosso Deus; buscamo-lo, e deu-nos repouso de todos os lados. Edificaram, pois, e prosperaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο τῷ Ασα δύναμις ὁπλοφόρων αἰρόντων θυρεοὺς καὶ δόρατα ἐν γῇ Ιουδα τριακόσιαι χιλιάδες καὶ ἐν γῇ Βενιαμιν πελτασταὶ καὶ τοξόται διακόσιαι καὶ πεντήκοντα χιλιάδες πάντες οὗτοι πολεμισταὶ δυνάμεως

text_en: And Zara the Ethiopian came out against them with his army of ten hundred thousand men , and with three hundred chariots: and he came as far as Maresa.
text_la: Egressus est autem contra eos Zara Æthiops cum exercitu suo, decies centena millia, et curribus trecentis : et venit usque Maresa.
text_pt: Tinha Asa um exército de trezentos mil de Judá, que traziam pavês e lança; e duzentos e oitenta mil de Benjamim, que traziam escudo e atiravam com arco; todos estes eram homens valentes.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς Ζαρε ὁ Αἰθίοψ ἐν δυνάμει ἐν χιλίαις χιλιάσιν καὶ ἅρμασιν τριακοσίοις καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως Μαρισα

text_en: And Asa went out to meet him, and set his army in array for battle in the vale of Sephata, which is near Maresa:
text_la: Porro Asa perrexit obviam ei, et instruxit aciem ad bellum in valle Sephata, quæ est juxta Maresa:
text_pt: E Zerá, o etíope, saiu contra eles, com um exército de um milhão e com trezentos carros, e chegou até Maressa.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ασα εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ καὶ παρετάξατο πόλεμον ἐν τῇ φάραγγι κατὰ βορρᾶν Μαρισης

text_en: And he called upon the Lord God , and said: Lord , there is no difference with you, whether you help with few, or with many: help us, O Lord our God : for with confidence in you, and in your name we have come against this multitude. O Lord you are our God , let not man prevail against you.
text_la: et invocavit Dominum Deum, et ait : Domine, non est apud te ulla distantia, utrum in paucis auxilieris, an in pluribus. Adjuva nos, Domine Deus noster : in te enim, et in tuo nomine habentes fiduciam, venimus contra hanc multitudinem. Domine, Deus noster tu es : non prævaleat contra te homo.
text_pt: Então Asa saiu contra ele; e ordenaram a batalha no vale de Zefatá, junto a Maressa.
text_el: καὶ ἐβόησεν Ασα πρὸς κύριον θεὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν κύριε οὐκ ἀδυνατεῖ παρὰ σοὶ σῴζειν ἐν πολλοῖς καὶ ἐν ὀλίγοις κατίσχυσον ἡμᾶς κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐπὶ σοὶ πεποίθαμεν καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματί σου ἤλθαμεν ἐπὶ τὸ πλῆθος τὸ πολὺ τοῦτο κύριε ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν μὴ κατισχυσάτω πρὸς σὲ ἄνθρωπος

text_en: And the Lord terrified the Ethiopians before Asa and Juda : and the Ethiopians fled.
text_la: Exterruit itaque Dominus Æthiopes coram Asa et Juda : fugeruntque Æthiopes.
text_pt: E Asa clamou ao Senhor seu Deus, e disse: Senhor, nada para ti é ajudar, quer o poderoso quer o de nenhuma força; ajuda-nos, pois, Senhor nosso Deus, porque em ti confiamos, e no teu nome viemos contra esta multidão. Senhor, tu és nosso Deus, não prevaleça contra ti o homem.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάταξεν κύριος τοὺς Αἰθίοπας ἐναντίον Ιουδα καὶ ἔφυγον οἱ Αἰθίοπες

text_en: And Asa and the people that were with him pursued them to Gerara: and the Ethiopians fell even to utter destruction, for the Lord slew them, and his army fought against them, and they were destroyed. And they took abundance of spoils,
text_la: Et persecutus est eos Asa, et populus qui cum eo erat, usque Gerara : et ruerunt Æthiopes usque ad internecionem, quia Domino cædente contriti sunt, et exercitu illius præliante. Tulerunt ergo spolia multa,
text_pt: E o Senhor feriu os etíopes diante de Asa e diante de Judá; e os etíopes fugiram.
text_el: καὶ κατεδίωξεν Ασα καὶ ὁ λαὸς αὐτοῦ ἕως Γεδωρ καὶ ἔπεσον Αἰθίοπες ὥστε μὴ εἶναι ἐν αὐτοῖς περιποίησιν ὅτι συνετρίβησαν ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ ἐναντίον τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐσκύλευσαν σκῦλα πολλά

text_en: and they took all the cities round about Gerara: for a great fear had come upon all men : and they pillaged the cities, and carried off much booty.
text_la: et percusserunt civitates omnes per circuitum Geraræ : grandis quippe cunctos terror invaserat : et diripuerunt urbes, et multam prædam asportaverunt.
text_pt: E Asa, e o povo que estava com ele os perseguiram até Gerar, e caíram tantos dos etíopes, que já não havia neles resistência alguma; porque foram destruídos diante do Senhor, e diante do seu exército; e levaram dali mui grande despojo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέκοψαν τὰς κώμας αὐτῶν κύκλῳ Γεδωρ ὅτι ἐγενήθη ἔκστασις κυρίου ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἐσκύλευσαν πάσας τὰς πόλεις αὐτῶν ὅτι πολλὰ σκῦλα ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they destroyed the sheepcotes, and took an infinite number of cattle, and of camels: and returned to Jerusalem .
text_la: Sed et caulas ovium destruentes, tulerunt pecorum infinitam multitudinem, et camelorum : reversique sunt in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E feriram todas as cidades nos arredores de Gerar, porque o terror do Senhor veio sobre elas; e saquearam todas as cidades, porque havia nelas muita presa.
text_el: καί γε σκηνὰς κτήσεων τοὺς Αμαζονεῖς ἐξέκοψαν καὶ ἔλαβον πρόβατα πολλὰ καὶ καμήλους καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And the spirit of God came upon Azarias the son of Oded,
text_la: Azarias autem filius Oded, facto in se spiritu Dei,
text_pt: Então veio o Espírito de Deus sobre Azarias, filho de Odede.
text_el: καὶ Αζαριας υἱὸς Ωδηδ ἐγένετο ἐπ' αὐτὸν πνεῦμα κυρίου

text_en: and he went out to meet Asa, and said to him: Hear me, Asa, and all Juda and Benjamin : The Lord is with you, because you have been with him. If you seek him, you shall find: but if you forsake him, he will forsake you.
text_la: egressus est in occursum Asa, et dixit ei : Audite me, Asa, et omnis Juda et Benjamin : Dominus vobiscum, quia fuistis cum eo. Si quæsieritis eum, invenietis : si autem dereliqueritis eum, derelinquet vos.
text_pt: E saiu ao encontro de Asa, e disse-lhe: Ouvi-me, Asa, e todo o Judá e Benjamim: O Senhor está convosco, enquanto vós estais com ele, e, se o buscardes, o achareis; porém, se o deixardes, vos deixará.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν εἰς ἀπάντησιν Ασα καὶ παντὶ Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ εἶπεν ἀκούσατέ μου Ασα καὶ πᾶς Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν κύριος μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ εἶναι ὑμᾶς μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐὰν ἐκζητήσητε αὐτόν εὑρεθήσεται ὑμῖν καὶ ἐὰν ἐγκαταλίπητε αὐτόν ἐγκαταλείψει ὑμᾶς

text_en: And many days shall pass in Israel , without the true God , and without a priest a teacher, and without the law.
text_la: Transibant autem multi dies in Israël absque Deo vero, et absque sacerdote doctore, et absque lege.
text_pt: E Israel esteve por muitos dias sem o verdadeiro Deus, e sem sacerdote que o ensinasse, e sem lei.
text_el: καὶ ἡμέραι πολλαὶ τῷ Ισραηλ ἐν οὐ θεῷ ἀληθινῷ καὶ οὐχ ἱερέως ὑποδεικνύοντος καὶ ἐν οὐ νόμῳ

text_en: And when in their distress they shall return to the Lord the God of Israel , and shall seek him, they shall find him.
text_la: Cumque reversi fuerint in angustia sua ad Dominum Deum Israël, et quæsierint eum, reperient eum.
text_pt: Mas quando na sua angústia voltaram para o Senhor Deus de Israel, e o buscaram, o acharam.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστρέψει ἐπὶ κύριον θεὸν Ισραηλ καὶ εὑρεθήσεται αὐτοῖς

text_en: At that time there shall be no peace to him that goes out and comes in, but terrors on every side among all the inhabitants of the earth.
text_la: In tempore illo, non erit pax egredienti et ingredienti, sed terrores undique in cunctis habitatoribus terrarum:
text_pt: E naqueles tempos não havia paz, nem para o que saía, nem para o que entrava, mas muitas perturbações sobre todos os habitantes daquelas terras.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῳ τῷ καιρῷ οὐκ ἔστιν εἰρήνη τῷ ἐκπορευομένῳ καὶ τῷ εἰσπορευομένῳ ὅτι ἔκστασις κυρίου ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὰς χώρας

text_en: For nation shall fight against nation, and city against city, for the Lord will trouble them with all distress.
text_la: pugnavit enim gens contra gentem, et civitas contra civitatem, quia Dominus conturbabit eos in omni angustia.
text_pt: Porque nação contra nação e cidade contra cidade se despedaçavam; porque Deus os perturbara com toda a angústia.
text_el: καὶ πολεμήσει ἔθνος πρὸς ἔθνος καὶ πόλις πρὸς πόλιν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ἐξέστησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν πάσῃ θλίψει

text_en: Do you therefore take courage , and let not your hands be weakened: for there shall be a reward for your work.
text_la: Vos ergo confortamini, et non dissolvantur manus vestræ : erit enim merces operi vestro.
text_pt: Mas esforçai-vos, e não desfaleçam as vossas mãos; porque a vossa obra tem uma recompensa.
text_el: καὶ ὑμεῖς ἰσχύσατε καὶ μὴ ἐκλυέσθωσαν αἱ χεῖρες ὑμῶν ὅτι ἔστιν μισθὸς τῇ ἐργασίᾳ ὑμῶν

text_en: And when Asa had heard the words, and the prophecy of Azarias the son of Oded the prophet , he took courage , and took away the idols out of all the land of Juda , and out of Benjamin , and out of the cities of mount Ephraim, which he had taken, and he dedicated the altar of the Lord , which was before the porch of the Lord .
text_la: Quod cum audisset Asa, verba scilicet, et prophetiam Azariæ filii Oded prophetæ, confortatus est, et abstulit idola de omni terra Juda et de Benjamin, et ex urbibus quas ceperat, montis Ephraim : et dedicavit altare Domini quod erat ante porticum Domini.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Asa estas palavras, e a profecia do profeta Odede, cobrou ânimo e tirou as abominações de toda a terra, de Judá e de Benjamim, como também das cidades que tomara nas montanhas de Efraim, e renovou o altar do Senhor, que estava diante do pórtico do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαι τοὺς λόγους τούτους καὶ τὴν προφητείαν Αδαδ τοῦ προφήτου καὶ κατίσχυσεν καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὰ βδελύγματα ἀπὸ πάσης τῆς γῆς Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πόλεων ὧν κατέσχεν ἐν ὄρει Εφραιμ καὶ ἐνεκαίνισεν τὸ θυσιαστήριον κυρίου ὃ ἦν ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ ναοῦ κυρίου

text_en: And he gathered together all Juda and Benjamin , and the strangers with them of Ephraim, and Manasses , and Simeon : for many had come over to him out of Israel , seeing that the Lord his God was with him.
text_la: Congregavitque universum Judam et Benjamin, et advenas cum eis de Ephraim, et de Manasse, et de Simeon : plures enim ad eum confugerant ex Israël, videntes quod Dominus Deus illius esset cum eo.
text_pt: E reuniu a todo o Judá, e Benjamim, e com eles os estrangeiros de Efraim e Manassés, e de Simeão; porque muitos de Israel tinham passado a ele, vendo que o Senhor seu Deus era com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκκλησίασεν τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ τοὺς προσηλύτους τοὺς παροικοῦντας μετ' αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ Εφραιμ καὶ ἀπὸ Μανασση καὶ ἀπὸ Συμεων ὅτι προσετέθησαν πρὸς αὐτὸν πολλοὶ τοῦ Ισραηλ ἐν τῷ ἰδεῖν αὐτοὺς ὅτι κύριος ὁ θεὸς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when they had come to Jerusalem in the third month, in the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa,
text_la: Cumque venissent in Jerusalem mense tertio, anno decimoquinto regni Asa,
text_pt: E ajuntaram-se em Jerusalém no terceiro mês; no ano décimo do reinado de Asa.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν τῷ μηνὶ τῷ τρίτῳ ἐν τῷ πεντεκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας Ασα

text_en: they sacrificed to the Lord in that day of the spoils, and of the prey, that they had brought, seven hundred oxen, and seven thousand rams.
text_la: immolaverunt Domino in die illa de manubiis et præda quam adduxerant, boves septingentos, et arietes septem millia.
text_pt: E no mesmo dia ofereceram em sacrifício ao Senhor, do despojo que trouxeram, setecentos bois e sete mil ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔθυσεν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἀπὸ τῶν σκύλων ὧν ἤνεγκαν μόσχους ἑπτακοσίους καὶ πρόβατα ἑπτακισχίλια

text_en: And he went in to confirm as usual the covenant, that they should seek the Lord the God of their fathers with all their heart, and with all their soul .
text_la: Et intravit ex more ad corroborandum fœdus ut quærerent Dominum Deum patrum suorum in toto corde, et in tota anima sua.
text_pt: E entraram na aliança para buscarem o Senhor Deus de seus pais, com todo o seu coração, e com toda a sua alma;
text_el: καὶ διῆλθεν ἐν διαθήκῃ ζητῆσαι κύριον θεὸν τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν ἐξ ὅλης τῆς καρδίας καὶ ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς

text_en: And if any one, said he, seek not the Lord the God of Israel , let him die, whether little or great, man or woman .
text_la: Si quis autem, inquit, non quæsierit Dominum Deum Israël, moriatur, a minimo usque ad maximum, a viro usque ad mulierem.
text_pt: E de que todo aquele que não buscasse ao Senhor Deus de Israel, morresse; assim o menor como o maior, tanto o homem como a mulher.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἐὰν μὴ ἐκζητήσῃ κύριον θεὸν Ισραηλ ἀποθανεῖται ἀπὸ νεωτέρου ἕως πρεσβυτέρου ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἕως γυναικός

text_en: And they swore to the Lord with a loud voice with joyful shouting, and with sound of trumpet, and sound of cornets,
text_la: Juraveruntque Domino voce magna in jubilo, et in clangore tubæ, et in sonitu buccinarum,
text_pt: E juraram ao Senhor, em alta voz, com júbilo e com trombetas e buzinas.
text_el: καὶ ὤμοσαν ἐν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν σάλπιγξιν καὶ ἐν κερατίναις

text_en: all that were in Juda with a curse : for with all their heart they swore , and with all their will they sought him, and they found him, and the Lord gave them rest round about.
text_la: omnes qui erant in Juda, cum execratione : in omni enim corde suo juraverunt, et in tota voluntate quæsierunt eum, et invenerunt : præstititque eis Dominus requiem per circuitum.
text_pt: E todo o Judá se alegrou deste juramento; porque de todo o seu coração juraram, e de toda a sua vontade o buscaram, e o acharam; e o Senhor lhes deu repouso ao redor.
text_el: καὶ ηὐφράνθησαν πᾶς Ιουδα περὶ τοῦ ὅρκου ὅτι ἐξ ὅλης τῆς ψυχῆς ὤμοσαν καὶ ἐν πάσῃ θελήσει ἐζήτησαν αὐτόν καὶ εὑρέθη αὐτοῖς καὶ κατέπαυσεν αὐτοῖς κύριος κυκλόθεν

text_en: Moreover Maacha the mother of King Asa he deposed from the royal authority, because she had made in a grove an idol of Priapus: and he entirely destroyed it, and breaking it into pieces, burnt it at the torrent Cedron .
text_la: Sed et Maacham matrem Asa regis ex augusto deposuit imperio, eo quod fecisset in luco simulacrum Priapi : quod omne contrivit, et in frustra comminuens combussit in torrente Cedron.
text_pt: E também a Maaca, sua mãe, o rei Asa depôs, para que não fosse mais rainha, porquanto fizera um horrível ídolo, a Aserá; e Asa destruiu o seu horrível ídolo, e o despedaçou, e o queimou junto ao ribeiro de Cedrom.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Μααχα τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ μετέστησεν τοῦ μὴ εἶναι τῇ Ἀστάρτῃ λειτουργοῦσαν καὶ κατέκοψεν τὸ εἴδωλον καὶ κατέκαυσεν ἐν χειμάρρῳ Κεδρων

text_en: But high places were left in Israel : nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
text_la: Excelsa autem derelicta sunt in Israël : attamen cor Asa erat perfectum cunctis diebus ejus,
text_pt: Os altos, porém, não foram tirados de Israel; contudo o coração de Asa foi perfeito todos os seus dias.
text_el: πλὴν τὰ ὑψηλὰ οὐκ ἀπέστησαν ἔτι ὑπῆρχεν ἐν τῷ Ισραηλ ἀλλ' ἢ καρδία Ασα ἐγένετο πλήρης πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the things which his father had vowed , and he himself had vowed , he brought into the house of the Lord , gold and silver, and vessels of divers uses.
text_la: eaque quæ voverat pater suus, et ipse, intulit in domum Domini, argentum, et aurum, vasorumque diversam supellectilem.
text_pt: E trouxe, à casa de Deus, as coisas consagradas por seu pai, e as coisas que ele mesmo tinha consagrado: prata, ouro e vasos.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τὰ ἅγια Δαυιδ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ ἅγια οἴκου κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον καὶ σκεύη

text_en: And there was no war unto the five and thirtieth year of the kingdom of Asa.
text_la: Bellum vero non fuit usque ad trigesimum quintum annum regni Asa.
text_pt: E não houve guerra até ao ano trigésimo quinto do reinado de Asa.
text_el: καὶ πόλεμος οὐκ ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἕως τοῦ πέμπτου καὶ τριακοστοῦ ἔτους τῆς βασιλείας Ασα

text_en: And in the six and thirtieth year of his kingdom, Baasa the king of Israel came up against Juda , and built a wall about Rama, that no one might safely go out or come in of the kingdom of Asa.
text_la: Anno autem trigesimo sexto regni ejus, ascendit Baasa rex Israël in Judam, et muro circumdabat Rama, ut nullus tute posset egredi et ingredi de regno Asa.
text_pt: No trigésimo sexto ano do reinado de Asa, Baasa, rei de Israel, subiu contra Judá e edificou a Ramá, para não deixar ninguém sair, nem chegar a Asa, rei de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ ὀγδόῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας Ασα ἀνέβη Βαασα βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ἐπὶ Ιουδαν καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Ραμα τοῦ μὴ δοῦναι ἔξοδον καὶ εἴσοδον τῷ Ασα βασιλεῖ Ιουδα

text_en: Then Asa brought out silver and gold out of the treasures of the house of the Lord , and of the king's treasures, and sent to Benadad king of Syria , who dwelt in Damascus , saying:
text_la: Protulit ergo Asa argentum et aurum de thesauris domus Domini, et de thesauris regis, misitque ad Benadad regem Syriæ, qui habitabat in Damasco, dicens:
text_pt: Então Asa tirou a prata e o ouro dos tesouros da casa do Senhor, e da casa do rei; e enviou servos a Ben-Hadade, rei da Síria, que habitava em Damasco, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ασα χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον ἐκ θησαυρῶν οἴκου κυρίου καὶ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τὸν υἱὸν τοῦ Αδερ βασιλέως Συρίας τὸν κατοικοῦντα ἐν Δαμασκῷ λέγων

text_en: There is a league between me and you, as there was between my father and your father, wherefore I have sent you silver and gold, that you may break your league with Baasa king of Israel , and make him depart from me.
text_la: Fœdus inter me et te est; pater quoque meus et pater tuus habuere concordiam : quam ob rem misi tibi argentum et aurum, ut rupto fœdere quod habes cum Baasa rege Israël, facias eum a me recedere.
text_pt: Acordo há entre mim e ti, como houve entre meu pai e o teu; eis que te envio prata e ouro; vai, pois, e anula o teu acordo com Baasa, rei de Israel, para que se retire de sobre mim.
text_el: διάθου διαθήκην ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πατρός σου ἰδοὺ ἀπέσταλκά σοι χρυσίον καὶ ἀργύριον δεῦρο καὶ διασκέδασον ἀπ' ἐμοῦ τὸν Βαασα βασιλέα Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπελθέτω ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: And when Benadad heard this, he sent the captains of his armies against the cities of Israel : and they took Ahion, and Dan , and Abelmaim , and all the walled cities of Nephtali .
text_la: Quo comperto, Benadad misit principes exercituum suorum ad urbes Israël : qui percusserunt Ahion, et Dan, et Abelmaim, et universas urbes Nephthali muratas.
text_pt: E Ben-Hadade deu ouvidos ao rei Asa, e enviou os capitães dos seus exércitos, contra as cidades de Israel, e eles feriram a Ijom, a Dã, a Abel-Maim, e a todas as cidades-armazéns de Naftali.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν υἱὸς Αδερ τοῦ βασιλέως Ασα καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις Ισραηλ καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὴν Ιων καὶ τὴν Δαν καὶ τὴν Αβελμαιν καὶ πάσας τὰς περιχώρους Νεφθαλι

text_en: And when Baasa heard of it, he left off the building of Rama, and interrupted his work.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Baasa, desiit ædificare Rama, et intermisit opus suum.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo-o Baasa, deixou de edificar a Ramá, e não continuou a sua obra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαι Βαασα ἀπέλιπεν τοῦ μηκέτι οἰκοδομεῖν τὴν Ραμα καὶ κατέπαυσεν τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then King Asa took all Juda , and they carried away from Rama the stones, and the timber that Baasa had prepared for the building: and he built with them Gabaa, and Maspha .
text_la: Porro Asa rex assumpsit universum Judam, et tulerunt lapides de Rama, et ligna quæ ædificationi præparaverat Baasa, ædificavitque ex eis Gabaa et Maspha.
text_pt: Então o rei Asa tomou a todo o Judá, e levaram as pedras de Ramá, e a sua madeira, com que Baasa edificara; e com elas edificou a Geba e a Mizpá.
text_el: καὶ Ασα ὁ βασιλεὺς ἔλαβεν πάντα τὸν Ιουδαν καὶ ἔλαβεν τοὺς λίθους τῆς Ραμα καὶ τὰ ξύλα αὐτῆς ἃ ᾠκοδόμησεν Βαασα καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐν αὐτοῖς τὴν Γαβαε καὶ τὴν Μασφα

text_en: At that time Hanani the prophet came to Asa king of Juda , and said to him: Because you have had confidence in the king of Syria , and not in the Lord your God , therefore has the army of the king of Syria escaped out of your hand.
text_la: In tempore illo venit Hanani propheta ad Asa regem Juda, et dixit ei : Quia habuisti fiduciam in rege Syriæ, et non in Domino Deo tuo, idcirco evasit Syriæ regis exercitus de manu tua.
text_pt: Naquele mesmo tempo veio Hanani, o vidente, a Asa, rei de Judá, e disse-lhe: Porquanto confiaste no rei da Síria, e não confiaste no Senhor teu Deus, por isso o exército do rei da Síria escapou da tua mão.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ ἦλθεν Ανανι ὁ προφήτης πρὸς Ασα βασιλέα Ιουδα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ πεποιθέναι σε ἐπὶ βασιλέα Συρίας καὶ μὴ πεποιθέναι σε ἐπὶ κύριον θεόν σου διὰ τοῦτο ἐσώθη δύναμις Συρίας ἀπὸ τῆς χειρός σου

text_en: Were not the Ethiopians , and the Libyans much more numerous in chariots, and horsemen, and an exceeding great multitude: yet because you trusted in the Lord , he delivered them into your hand?
text_la: Nonne Æthiopes et Libyes multo plures erant quadrigis, et equitibus, et multitudine nimia, quos cum Domino credidisses, tradidit in manu tua?
text_pt: Porventura não foram os etíopes e os líbios um grande exército, com muitíssimos carros e cavaleiros? Confiando tu, porém, no Senhor, ele os entregou nas tuas mãos.
text_el: οὐχ οἱ Αἰθίοπες καὶ Λίβυες ἦσαν εἰς δύναμιν πολλὴν εἰς θάρσος εἰς ἱππεῖς εἰς πλῆθος σφόδρα καὶ ἐν τῷ πεποιθέναι σε ἐπὶ κύριον παρέδωκεν εἰς τὰς χεῖράς σου

text_en: For the eyes of the Lord behold all the earth, and give strength to those who with a perfect heart trust in him. Wherefore you have done foolishly, and for this cause from this time wars shall arise against you.
text_la: Oculi enim Domini contemplantur universam terram, et præbent fortitudinem his qui corde perfecto credunt in eum. Stulte igitur egisti, et propter hoc ex præsenti tempore adversum te bella consurgent.
text_pt: Porque, quanto ao Senhor, seus olhos passam por toda a terra, para mostrar-se forte para com aqueles cujo coração é perfeito para com ele; nisto, pois, procedeste loucamente porque desde agora haverá guerras contra ti.
text_el: ὅτι οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ κυρίου ἐπιβλέπουσιν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ κατισχῦσαι ἐν πάσῃ καρδίᾳ πλήρει πρὸς αὐτόν ἠγνόηκας ἐπὶ τούτῳ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἔσται μετὰ σοῦ πόλεμος

text_en: And Asa was angry with the seer, and commanded him to be put in prison: for he was greatly enraged because of this thing: and he put to death many of the people at that time.
text_la: Iratusque Asa adversus videntem, jussit eum mitti in nervum : valde quippe super hoc fuerat indignatus : et interfecit de populo in tempore illo plurimos.
text_pt: Porém Asa se indignou contra o vidente, e lançou-o na casa do tronco; porque estava enfurecido contra ele, por causa disto; também Asa, no mesmo tempo, oprimiu a alguns do povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐθυμώθη Ασα τῷ προφήτῃ καὶ παρέθετο αὐτὸν εἰς φυλακήν ὅτι ὠργίσθη ἐπὶ τούτῳ καὶ ἐλυμήνατο Ασα ἐν τῷ λαῷ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: But the works of Asa the first and last are written in the book of the kings of Juda and Israel .
text_la: Opera autem Asa prima et novissima scripta sunt in libro regum Juda et Israël.
text_pt: E eis que os atos de Asa, tanto os primeiros, como os últimos, estão escritos no livro dos reis de Judá e Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ λόγοι Ασα οἱ πρῶτοι καὶ οἱ ἔσχατοι γεγραμμένοι ἐν βιβλίῳ βασιλέων Ιουδα καὶ Ισραηλ

text_en: And Asa fell sick in the nine and thirtieth year of his reign, of a most violent pain in his feet, and yet in his illness he did not seek the Lord , but rather trusted in the skill of physicians.
text_la: Ægrotavit etiam Asa anno trigesimo nono regni sui, dolore pedum vehementissimo, et nec in infirmitate sua quæsivit Dominum, sed magis in medicorum arte confisus est.
text_pt: E, no ano trinta e nove do seu reinado, Asa caiu doente de seus pés, a sua doença era em extremo grave; contudo, na sua enfermidade, não buscou ao Senhor, mas antes os médicos.
text_el: καὶ ἐμαλακίσθη Ασα ἐν τῷ ἐνάτῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ τοὺς πόδας ἕως σφόδρα ἐμαλακίσθη καὶ ἐν τῇ μαλακίᾳ αὐτοῦ οὐκ ἐζήτησεν κύριον ἀλλὰ τοὺς ἰατρούς

text_en: And he slept with his fathers: and he died in the one and fortieth year of his reign.
text_la: Dormivitque cum patribus suis, et mortuus est anno quadragesimo primo regni sui.
text_pt: E Asa dormiu com seus pais; e morreu no ano quarenta e um do seu reinado.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη Ασα μετὰ τῶν πατέρων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν ἐν τῷ ἐνάτῳ καὶ τριακοστῷ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they buried him in his own sepulchre, which he had made for himself in the city of David: and they laid him on his bed full of spices and odoriferous ointments , which were made by the art of the perfumers, and they burnt them over him with very great pomp.
text_la: Et sepelierunt eum in sepulchro suo quod foderat sibi in civitate David : posueruntque eum super lectum suum plenum aromatibus et unguentibus meretriciis, quæ erant pigmentariorum arte confecta, et combusserunt super eum ambitione nimia.
text_pt: E o sepultaram no seu sepulcro, que tinha cavado para si na cidade de Davi, havendo-o deitado na cama, que se enchera de perfumes e especiarias preparadas segundo a arte dos perfumistas; e, destas coisas fizeram-lhe uma grande queima.
text_el: καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ μνήματι ᾧ ὤρυξεν ἑαυτῷ ἐν πόλει Δαυιδ καὶ ἐκοίμισαν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τῆς κλίνης καὶ ἔπλησαν ἀρωμάτων καὶ γένη μύρων μυρεψῶν καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ ἐκφορὰν μεγάλην ἕως σφόδρα

text_en: And Josaphat his son reigned in his stead, and grew strong against Israel .
text_la: Regnavit autem Josaphat filius ejus pro eo, et invaluit contra Israël.
text_pt: E Jeosafá, seu filho, reinou em seu lugar; e fortificou-se contra Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν Ιωσαφατ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἀντ' αὐτοῦ καὶ κατίσχυσεν Ιωσαφατ ἐπὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And he placed numbers of soldiers in all the fortified cities of Juda . And he put garrisons in the land of Juda , and in the cities of Ephraim, which Asa his father had taken.
text_la: Constituitque militum numeros in cunctis urbibus Juda quæ erant vallatæ muris. Præsidiaque disposuit in terra Juda, et in civitatibus Ephraim quas ceperat Asa pater ejus.
text_pt: E pôs soldados em todas as cidades fortificadas de Judá, e estabeleceu guarnições na terra de Judá, como também nas cidades de Efraim, que Asa seu pai tinha tomado.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν δύναμιν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα ταῖς ὀχυραῖς καὶ κατέστησεν ἡγουμένους ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν Εφραιμ ἃς προκατελάβετο Ασα ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the Lord was with Josaphat, because he walked in the first ways of David his father: and trusted not in Baalim ,
text_la: Et fuit Dominus cum Josaphat, quia ambulavit in viis David patris sui primis : et non speravit in Baalim,
text_pt: E o Senhor era com Jeosafá; porque andou nos primeiros caminhos de Davi seu pai, e não buscou a Baalins.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο κύριος μετὰ Ιωσαφατ ὅτι ἐπορεύθη ἐν ὁδοῖς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ταῖς πρώταις καὶ οὐκ ἐξεζήτησεν τὰ εἴδωλα

text_en: but in the God of his father, and walked in his commandments, and not according to the sins of Israel .
text_la: sed in Deo patris sui : et perrexit in præceptis illius, et non juxta peccata Israël.
text_pt: Antes buscou ao Deus de seu pai, andou nos seus mandamentos, e não segundo as obras de Israel.
text_el: ἀλλὰ κύριον τὸν θεὸν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐξεζήτησεν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐπορεύθη καὶ οὐχ ὡς τοῦ Ισραηλ τὰ ἔργα

text_en: And the Lord established the kingdom in his hand, and all Juda brought presents to Josaphat: and he acquired immense riches, and much glory .
text_la: Confirmavitque Dominus regnum in manu ejus, et dedit omnis Juda munera Josaphat : factæque sunt ei infinitæ divitiæ, et multa gloria.
text_pt: E o Senhor confirmou o reino na sua mão, e todo o Judá deu presentes a Jeosafá, o qual teve riquezas e glória em abundância.
text_el: καὶ κατηύθυνεν κύριος τὴν βασιλείαν ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν πᾶς Ιουδα δῶρα τῷ Ιωσαφατ καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ πλοῦτος καὶ δόξα πολλή

text_en: And when his heart had taken courage for the ways of the Lord , he took away also the high places and the groves out of Juda .
text_la: Cumque sumpsisset cor ejus audaciam propter vias Domini, etiam excelsa et lucos de Juda abstulit.
text_pt: E exaltou-se o seu coração nos caminhos do Senhor e, ainda mais, tirou os altos e os bosques de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ὑψώθη καρδία αὐτοῦ ἐν ὁδῷ κυρίου καὶ ἔτι ἐξῆρεν τὰ ὑψηλὰ καὶ τὰ ἄλση ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς Ιουδα

text_en: And in the third year of his reign, he sent of his princes Benhail, and Abdias, and Zacharias, and Nathanael, and Micah , to teach in the cites of Juda :
text_la: Tertio autem anno regni sui misit de principibus suis Benhail, et Obdiam, et Zachariam, et Nathanaël, et Michæam, ut docerent in civitatibus Juda:
text_pt: E no terceiro ano do seu reinado enviou ele os seus príncipes, a Bene-Hail, a Obadias, a Zacarias, a Natanael e a Micaías, para ensinarem nas cidades de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ τρίτῳ ἔτει τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν τοὺς ἡγουμένους αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς τῶν δυνατῶν τὸν Αβδιαν καὶ Ζαχαριαν καὶ Ναθαναηλ καὶ Μιχαιαν διδάσκειν ἐν πόλεσιν Ιουδα

text_en: And with them the Levites , Semeias, and Nathanias, and Zabadias, and Asael, and Semiramoth, and Jonathan , and Adonias , and Tobias, and Thobadonias Levites , and with them Elisama, and Joram priests .
text_la: et cum eis Levitas Semeiam, et Nathaniam, et Zabadiam, Asaël quoque, et Semiramoth, et Jonathan, Adoniamque et Thobiam, et Thobadoniam Levitas, et cum eis Elisama, et Joran sacerdotes:
text_pt: E com eles os levitas, Semaías, Netanias, Zebadias, Asael, Semiramote, Jônatas, Adonias, Tobias e Tobe-Adonias e, com estes levitas, os sacerdotes, Elisama e Jeorão.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν οἱ Λευῖται Σαμουιας καὶ Ναθανιας καὶ Ζαβδιας καὶ Ασιηλ καὶ Σεμιραμωθ καὶ Ιωναθαν καὶ Αδωνιας καὶ Τωβιας οἱ Λευῖται καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν Ελισαμα καὶ Ιωραμ οἱ ἱερεῖς

text_en: And they taught the people in Juda , having with them the book of the law of the Lord : and they went about all the cities of Juda , and instructed the people.
text_la: docebantque populum in Juda, habentes librum legis Domini, et circuibant cunctas urbes Juda, atque erudiebant populum.
text_pt: E ensinaram em Judá, levando consigo o livro da lei do Senhor; e foram a todas as cidades de Judá, ensinando entre o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἐδίδασκον ἐν Ιουδα καὶ μετ' αὐτῶν βύβλος νόμου κυρίου καὶ διῆλθον ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν Ιουδα καὶ ἐδίδασκον τὸν λαόν

text_en: And the fear of the Lord came upon all the kingdoms of the lands that were round about Juda , and they dared not make war against Josaphat.
text_la: Itaque factus est pavor Domini super omnia regna terrarum quæ erant per gyrum Juda, nec audebant bellare contra Josaphat.
text_pt: E veio o temor do Senhor sobre todos os reinos das terras, que estavam ao redor de Judá, e não guerrearam contra Jeosafá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἔκστασις κυρίου ἐπὶ πάσαις ταῖς βασιλείαις τῆς γῆς ταῖς κύκλῳ Ιουδα καὶ οὐκ ἐπολέμουν πρὸς Ιωσαφατ

text_en: The Philistines also brought presents to Josaphat, and tribute in silver, and the Arabians brought him cattle, seven thousand seven hundred rams, and as many he goats.
text_la: Sed et Philisthæi Josaphat munera deferebant, et vectigal argenti : Arabes quoque adducebant pecora, arietum septem millia septingenta, et hircorum totidem.
text_pt: E alguns dentre os filisteus traziam presentes a Jeosafá, e prata como tributo; também os árabes lhe trouxeram gado miúdo; sete mil e setecentos carneiros, e sete mil e setecentos bodes.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἀλλοφύλων ἔφερον τῷ Ιωσαφατ δῶρα καὶ ἀργύριον καὶ δόματα καὶ οἱ Ἄραβες ἔφερον αὐτῷ κριοὺς προβάτων ἑπτακισχιλίους ἑπτακοσίους

text_en: And Josaphat grew, and became exceeding great: and he built in Juda houses like towers, and walled cities.
text_la: Crevit ergo Josaphat, et magnificatus est usque in sublime : atque ædificavit in Juda domos ad instar turrium, urbesque muratas.
text_pt: Cresceu, pois, Jeosafá grandemente em extremo e edificou fortalezas e cidades de provisões em Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Ιωσαφατ πορευόμενος μείζων ἕως εἰς ὕψος καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν οἰκήσεις ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ καὶ πόλεις ὀχυράς

text_en: And he prepared many works in the cities of Juda : and he had warriors, and valiant men in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et multa opera paravit in urbibus Juda: viri quoque bellatores et robusti erant in Jerusalem,
text_pt: E teve muitas obras nas cidades de Judá, e homens de guerra e valentes, em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἔργα πολλὰ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ ἐν τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ καὶ ἄνδρες πολεμισταὶ δυνατοὶ ἰσχύοντες ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Of whom this is the number of the houses and families of every one: in Juda captains of the army, Ednas the chief, and with him three hundred thousand most valiant men .
text_la: quorum iste numerus per domos atque familias singulorum : in Juda principes exercitus, Ednas dux, et cum eo robustissimi viri trecenta millia.
text_pt: E este é o número deles segundo as suas casas paternas; em Judá eram capitàes dos milhares: o chefe Adna, e com ele trezentos mil homens valentes;
text_el: καὶ οὗτος ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν κατ' οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν τῷ Ιουδα χιλίαρχοι Εδνας ὁ ἄρχων καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ υἱοὶ δυνατοὶ δυνάμεως τριακόσιαι χιλιάδες

text_en: After him Johanan the captain , and with him two hundred and eighty thousand.
text_la: Post hunc Johanan princeps, et cum eo ducenta octoginta millia.
text_pt: E depois dele o capitão Joanã, e com ele duzentos e oitenta mil;
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Ιωαναν ὁ ἡγούμενος καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ διακόσιαι ὀγδοήκοντα χιλιάδες

text_en: And after him was Amasias the son of Zechri, consecrated to the Lord , and with him were two hundred thousand valiant men .
text_la: Post istum quoque Amasias filius Zechri, consecratus Domino, et cum eo ducenta millia virorum fortium.
text_pt: E depois Amasias, filho de Zicri, que voluntariamente se entregou ao Senhor, e com ele duzentos mil homens valentes;
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Αμασιας ὁ τοῦ Ζαχρι ὁ προθυμούμενος τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ διακόσιαι χιλιάδες δυνατοὶ δυνάμεως

text_en: After him was Eliada valiant in battle, and with him two hundred thousand armed with bow and shield.
text_la: Hunc sequebatur robustus ad prælia Eliada, et cum eo tenentium arcum et clypeum ducenta millia.
text_pt: E de Benjamim, Eliada, homem valente, e com ele duzentos mil, armados de arco e de escudo;
text_el: καὶ ἐκ τοῦ Βενιαμιν δυνατὸς δυνάμεως Ελιαδα καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ τοξόται καὶ πελτασταὶ διακόσιαι χιλιάδες

text_en: After him also was Jozabad, and with him a hundred and eighty thousand ready for war .
text_la: Post istum etiam Jozabad, et cum eo centum octoginta millia expeditorum militum.
text_pt: E depois dele Jozabade, e com ele cento e oitenta mil, armados para a guerra.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Ιωζαβαδ καὶ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα χιλιάδες δυνατοὶ πολέμου

text_en: All these were at the hand of the king, beside others, whom he had put in the walled cities, in all Juda .
text_la: Hi omnes erant ad manum regis, exceptis aliis quos posuerat in urbibus muratis in universo Juda.
text_pt: Estes estavam no serviço do rei; afora os que o rei tinha posto nas cidades fortes por todo o Judá.
text_el: οὗτοι οἱ λειτουργοῦντες τῷ βασιλεῖ ἐκτὸς ὧν ἔδωκεν ὁ βασιλεὺς ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν ταῖς ὀχυραῖς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ Ιουδαίᾳ

text_en: Now Josaphat was rich and very glorious , and was joined by affinity to Achab .
text_la: Fuit ergo Josaphat dives et inclytus multum, et affinitate conjunctus est Achab.
text_pt: Tinha, pois, Jeosafá riquezas e glória em abundância, e aparentou-se com Acabe.
text_el: καὶ ἐγενήθη τῷ Ιωσαφατ ἔτι πλοῦτος καὶ δόξα πολλή καὶ ἐπεγαμβρεύσατο ἐν οἴκῳ Αχααβ

text_en: And he went down to him after some years to Samaria : and Achab at his coming killed sheep and oxen in abundance for him and the people that came with him: and he persuaded him to go up to Ramoth Galaad.
text_la: Descenditque post annos ad eum in Samariam : ad cujus adventum mactavit Achab arietes et boves plurimos, ipsi, et populo qui venerat cum eo : persuasitque illi ut ascenderet in Ramoth Galaad.
text_pt: E depois de alguns anos desceu ele para Acabe em Samaria; e Acabe matou ovelhas e bois em abundância, para ele e para o povo que vinha com ele; e o persuadiu a subir com ele a Ramote de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ κατέβη διὰ τέλους ἐτῶν πρὸς Αχααβ εἰς Σαμάρειαν καὶ ἔθυσεν αὐτῷ Αχααβ πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους πολλοὺς καὶ τῷ λαῷ τῷ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἠπάτα αὐτὸν τοῦ συναναβῆναι μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς Ραμωθ τῆς Γαλααδίτιδος

text_en: And Achab king of Israel said to Josaphat king of Juda : Come with me to Ramoth Galaad. And he answered him: You are as I am, and my people as your people, and we will be with you in the war .
text_la: Dixitque Achab rex Israël ad Josaphat regem Juda : Veni mecum in Ramoth Galaad. Cui ille respondit : Ut ego, et tu : sicut populus tuus, sic et populus meus : tecumque erimus in bello.
text_pt: Porque Acabe, rei de Israel, disse a Jeosafá, rei de Judá: Irás tu comigo a Ramote de Gileade? E ele lhe disse: Como tu és, serei eu; e o meu povo, como o teu povo; iremos contigo à guerra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αχααβ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ βασιλέα Ιουδα πορεύσῃ μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰς Ραμωθ τῆς Γαλααδίτιδος καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὡς ἐγώ οὕτως καὶ σύ ὡς ὁ λαός σου καὶ ὁ λαός μου μετὰ σοῦ εἰς πόλεμον

text_en: And Josaphat said to the king of Israel : Inquire, I beseech you, at present the word of the Lord .
text_la: Dixitque Josaphat ad regem Israël : Consule, obsecro, impræsentiarum sermonem Domini.
text_pt: Disse mais Jeosafá ao rei de Israel: Peço-te, consulta hoje a palavra do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ πρὸς βασιλέα Ισραηλ ζήτησον δὴ σήμερον τὸν κύριον

text_en: So the king of Israel gathered together of the prophets four hundred men , and he said to them: Shall we go to Ramoth Galaad to fight, or shall we forbear? But they said: Go up, and God will deliver into the king's hand.
text_la: Congregavit igitur rex Israël prophetarum quadringentos viros, et dixit ad eos : In Ramoth Galaad ad bellandum ire debemus, an quiescere? At illi : Ascende, inquiunt, et tradet Deus in manu regis.
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel reuniu os profetas, quatrocentos homens, e disse-lhes: Iremos à guerra contra Ramote de Gileade, ou deixarei de ir? E eles disseram: Sobe; porque Deus a entregará na mão do rei.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ τοὺς προφήτας τετρακοσίους ἄνδρας καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰ πορευθῶ εἰς Ραμωθ Γαλααδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω καὶ εἶπαν ἀνάβαινε καὶ δώσει ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὰς χεῖρας τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And Josaphat said: Is there not here a prophet of the Lord , that we may inquire also of him?
text_la: Dixitque Josaphat : Numquid non est hic prophetes Domini, ut ab illo etiam requiramus?
text_pt: Disse, porém, Jeosafá: Não há ainda aqui algum profeta do Senhor, para que o consultemos?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ οὐκ ἔστιν ὧδε προφήτης τοῦ κυρίου ἔτι καὶ ἐπιζητήσομεν παρ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat: There is one man , of whom we may ask the will of the Lord : but I hate him, for he never prophesies good to me, but always evil : and it is Micah the son of Jemla . And Josaphat said: Speak not thus, O king.
text_la: Et ait rex Israël ad Josaphat : Est vir unus a quo possumus quærere Domini voluntatem : sed ego odi eum, quia non prophetat mihi bonum, sed malum omni tempore : est autem Michæas filius Jemla. Dixitque Josaphat : Ne loquaris, rex, hoc modo.
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel disse a Jeosafá: Ainda há um homem por quem podemos consultar ao Senhor; porém eu o odeio, porque nunca profetiza de mim o que é bom, senão sempre o mal; este é Micaías, filho de Inlá. E disse Jeosafá: Não fale o rei assim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ ἔτι ἀνὴρ εἷς τοῦ ζητῆσαι τὸν κύριον δι' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ ἐμίσησα αὐτόν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν προφητεύων περὶ ἐμοῦ εἰς ἀγαθά ὅτι πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτοῦ εἰς κακά οὗτος Μιχαιας υἱὸς Ιεμλα καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσαφατ μὴ λαλείτω ὁ βασιλεὺς οὕτως

text_en: And the king of Israel called one of the eunuchs, and said to him: Call quickly Micah the son of Jemla .
text_la: Vocavit ergo rex Israël unum de eunuchis, et dixit ei : Voca cito Michæam filium Jemla.
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel chamou um oficial, e disse: Traze aqui depressa a Micaías, filho de Inlá.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ εὐνοῦχον ἕνα καὶ εἶπεν τάχος Μιχαιαν υἱὸν Ιεμλα

text_en: Now the king of Israel , and Josaphat king of Juda , both sat on their thrones, clothed in royal robes, and they sat in the open court by the gate of Samaria , and all the prophets prophesied before them.
text_la: Porro rex Israël, et Josaphat rex Juda, uterque sedebant in solio suo, vestiti cultu regio : sedebant autem in area juxta portam Samariæ, omnesque prophetæ vaticinabantur coram eis.
text_pt: E o rei de Israel, e Jeosafá, rei de Judá, estavam assentados cada um no seu trono, vestidos com suas roupas reais, e estavam assentados na praça à entrada da porta de Samaria; e todos os profetas profetizavam na sua presença.
text_el: καὶ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα καθήμενοι ἕκαστος ἐπὶ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνδεδυμένοι στολὰς καθήμενοι ἐν τῷ εὐρυχώρῳ θύρας πύλης Σαμαρείας καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον ἐναντίον αὐτῶν

text_en: And Sedecias the son of Chanaana made him horns of iron, and said: Thus says the Lord : With these shall you push Syria , till you destroy it.
text_la: Sedecias vero filius Chanaana fecit sibi cornua ferrea, et ait : Hæc dicit Dominus : His ventilabis Syriam, donec conteras eam.
text_pt: E Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, fez para si uns chifres de ferro, e disse: Assim diz o Senhor: Com estes ferirás aos sírios, até de todo os consumires.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ Σεδεκιας υἱὸς Χανανα κέρατα σιδηρᾶ καὶ εἶπεν τάδε λέγει κύριος ἐν τούτοις κερατιεῖς τὴν Συρίαν ἕως ἂν συντελεσθῇ

text_en: And all the prophets prophesied in like manner, and said: Go up to Ramoth Galaad, and you shall prosper, and the Lord will deliver them into the king's hand.
text_la: Omnesque prophetæ similiter prophetabant, atque dicebant : Ascende in Ramoth Galaad, et prosperaberis, et tradet eos Dominus in manu regis.
text_pt: E todos os profetas profetizavam o mesmo, dizendo: Sobe a Ramote de Gileade, e triunfarás; porque o Senhor a dará na mão do rei.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ προφῆται ἐπροφήτευον οὕτως λέγοντες ἀνάβαινε εἰς Ραμωθ Γαλααδ καὶ εὐοδωθήσῃ καὶ δώσει κύριος εἰς χεῖρας τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And the messenger that went to call Micah , said to him: Behold the words of all the prophets with one mouth declare good to the king: I beseech you therefore let not your word disagree with them, and speak also good success.
text_la: Nuntius autem qui ierat ad vocandum Michæam, ait illi : En verba omnium prophetarum uno ore bona regi annuntiant : quæso ergo te ut et sermo tuus ab eis non dissentiat, loquarisque prospera.
text_pt: E o mensageiro, que foi chamar a Micaías, falou-lhe, dizendo: Eis que as palavras dos profetas, a uma voz, predizem coisas boas para o rei; seja, pois, também a tua palavra como a de um deles, e fala o que é bom.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ πορευθεὶς τοῦ καλέσαι τὸν Μιχαιαν ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ λέγων ἰδοὺ ἐλάλησαν οἱ προφῆται ἐν στόματι ἑνὶ ἀγαθὰ περὶ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἔστωσαν δὴ οἱ λόγοι σου ὡς ἑνὸς αὐτῶν καὶ λαλήσεις ἀγαθά

text_en: And Micah answered him: As the Lord lives, whatsoever my God shall say to me, that will I speak.
text_la: Cui respondit Michæas : Vivit Dominus, quia quodcumque dixerit mihi Deus meus, hoc loquar.
text_pt: Porém Micaías disse: Vive o Senhor, que o que meu Deus me disser, isso falarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας ζῇ κύριος ὅτι ὃ ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὁ θεὸς πρός με αὐτὸ λαλήσω

text_en: So he came to the king: and the king said to him: Micah , shall we go to Ramoth Galaad to fight, or forbear? And he answered him: Go up, for all shall succeed prosperously, and the enemies shall be delivered into your hands.
text_la: Venit ergo ad regem. Cui rex ait : Michæa, ire debemus in Ramoth Galaad ad bellandum, an quiescere? Cui ille respondit : Ascendite : cuncta enim prospera evenient, et tradentur hostes in manus vestras.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, ele ao rei, este lhe disse: Micaías, iremos a Ramote de Gileade à guerra, ou deixaremos de ir? E ele disse: Subi, e triunfarás; e serão dados na vossa mão.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς Μιχαια εἰ πορευθῶ εἰς Ραμωθ Γαλααδ εἰς πόλεμον ἢ ἐπίσχω καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάβαινε καὶ εὐοδώσεις καὶ δοθήσονται εἰς χεῖρας ὑμῶν

text_en: And the king said: I adjure you again and again to say nothing but the truth to me, in the name of the Lord .
text_la: Dixitque rex : Iterum atque iterum te adjuro, ut mihi non loquaris, nisi quod verum est in nomine Domini.
text_pt: E o rei lhe disse: Até quantas vezes, te conjurarei, para que não me fales senão a verdade em nome do Senhor?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ βασιλεύς ποσάκις ὁρκίζω σε ἵνα μὴ λαλήσῃς πρός με πλὴν ἀλήθειαν ἐν ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: Then he said: I saw all Israel scattered in the mountains, like sheep without a shepherd: and the Lord said: These have no masters: let every man return to his own house in peace.
text_la: At ille ait : Vidi universum Israël dispersum in montibus, sicut oves absque pastore : et dixit Dominus : Non habent isti dominos : revertatur unusquisque in domum suam in pace.
text_pt: Então disse ele: Vi a todo o Israel disperso pelos montes, como ovelhas que não têm pastor; e disse o SENHOR: Estes não têm senhor; torne cada um em paz para sua casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν εἶδον τὸν Ισραηλ διεσπαρμένους ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν ὡς πρόβατα οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ποιμήν καὶ εἶπεν κύριος οὐκ ἔχουσιν ἡγούμενον ἀναστρεφέτωσαν ἕκαστος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat: Did I not tell you that this man would not prophesy me any good , but evil ?
text_la: Et ait rex Israël ad Josaphat : Nonne dixi tibi quod non prophetaret iste mihi quidquam boni, sed ea quæ mala sunt?
text_pt: Então o rei de Israel disse a Jeosafá: Não te disse eu, que ele não profetizaria de mim o que é bom, porém sempre o mal?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ οὐκ εἶπά σοι ὅτι οὐ προφητεύει περὶ ἐμοῦ ἀγαθά ἀλλ' ἢ κακά

text_en: Then he said: Hear therefore the word of the Lord : I saw the Lord sitting on his throne, and all the army of heaven standing by him on the right hand and on the left,
text_la: At ille : Idcirco, ait, audite verbum Domini : vidi Dominum sedentem in solio suo, et omnem exercitum cæli assistentem ei a dextris et a sinistris.
text_pt: Disse mais: Ouvi, pois, a palavra do Senhor: Vi ao Senhor assentado no seu trono, e todo o exército celestial em pé à sua mão direita, e à sua esquerda.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν οὐχ οὕτως ἀκούσατε λόγον κυρίου εἶδον τὸν κύριον καθήμενον ἐπὶ θρόνου αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσα δύναμις τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἱστήκει ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: and the Lord said: Who shall deceive Achab king of Israel , that he may go up and fall in Ramoth Galaad? And when one spoke in this manner, and another otherwise:
text_la: Et dixit Dominus : Quis decipiet Achab regem Israël ut ascendat et corruat in Ramoth Galaad? Cumque diceret unus hoc modo, et alter alio,
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Quem persuadirá a Acabe rei de Israel, para que suba, e caia em Ramote de Gileade? Um dizia desta maneira, e outro de outra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τίς ἀπατήσει τὸν Αχααβ βασιλέα Ισραηλ καὶ ἀναβήσεται καὶ πεσεῖται ἐν Ραμωθ Γαλααδ καὶ εἶπεν οὗτος οὕτως καὶ οὗτος εἶπεν οὕτως

text_en: There came forth a spirit, and stood before the Lord , and said: I will deceive him. And the Lord said to him: By what means will you deceive him?
text_la: processit spiritus, et stetit coram Domino, et ait : Ego decipiam eum. Cui Dominus : In quo, inquit, decipies?
text_pt: Então saiu um espírito e se apresentou diante do Senhor, e disse: Eu o persuadirei. E o Senhor lhe disse: Com quê?
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἔστη ἐνώπιον κυρίου καὶ εἶπεν ἐγὼ ἀπατήσω αὐτόν καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἐν τίνι

text_en: And he answered: I will go out, and be a lying spirit in the mouth of all his prophets . And the Lord said: You shall deceive, and shall prevail: go out, and do so.
text_la: At ille respondit : Egrediar, et ero spiritus mendax in ore omnium prophetarum ejus. Dixitque Dominus : Decipies, et prævalebis : egredere, et fac ita.
text_pt: E ele disse: Eu sairei, e serei um espírito de mentira na boca de todos os seus profetas. E disse o Senhor: Tu o persuadirás, e ainda prevalecerás; sai, e faze-o assim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐξελεύσομαι καὶ ἔσομαι πνεῦμα ψευδὲς ἐν στόματι πάντων τῶν προφητῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἀπατήσεις καὶ δυνήσῃ ἔξελθε καὶ ποίησον οὕτως

text_en: Now therefore behold the Lord has put a spirit of lying in the mouth of all your prophets , and the Lord has spoken evil against you.
text_la: Nunc igitur, ecce Dominus dedit spiritum mendacii in ore omnium prophetarum tuorum, et Dominus locutus est de te mala.
text_pt: Agora, pois, eis que o Senhor pôs um espírito de mentira na boca destes teus profetas; e o Senhor falou o mal a teu respeito.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἔδωκεν κύριος πνεῦμα ψευδὲς ἐν στόματι πάντων τῶν προφητῶν σου τούτων καὶ κύριος ἐλάλησεν ἐπὶ σὲ κακά

text_en: And Sedecias the son of Chanaana came, and struck Micah on the cheek and said: Which way went the spirit of the Lord from me, to speak to you?
text_la: Accessit autem Sedecias filius Chanaana, et percussit Michææ maxillam, et ait : Per quam viam transivit spiritus Domini a me, ut loqueretur tibi?
text_pt: Então Zedequias, filho de Quenaaná, chegando-se, feriu a Micaías no queixo, e disse: Por que caminho passou de mim o Espírito do Senhor para falar a ti?
text_el: καὶ ἤγγισεν Σεδεκιας υἱὸς Χανανα καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν Μιχαιαν ἐπὶ τὴν σιαγόνα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ποίᾳ τῇ ὁδῷ παρῆλθεν πνεῦμα κυρίου παρ' ἐμοῦ τοῦ λαλῆσαι πρὸς σέ

text_en: And Micah said: You yourself shall see in that day, when you shall go in from chamber to chamber, to hide yourself.
text_la: Dixitque Michæas : Tu ipse videbis in die illo, quando ingressus fueris cubiculum de cubiculo ut abscondaris.
text_pt: E disse Micaías: Eis que o verás naquele dia, quando andares de câmara em câmara, para te esconderes.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας ἰδοὺ ὄψῃ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἐν ᾗ εἰσελεύσῃ ταμίειον ἐκ ταμιείου τοῦ κατακρυβῆναι

text_en: And the king of Israel commanded, saying: Take Micah , and carry him to Amon the governor of the city, and to Joas the son of Amelech,
text_la: Præcepit autem rex Israël, dicens : Tollite Michæam, et ducite eum ad Amon principem civitatis, et ad Joas filium Amelech.
text_pt: Então disse o rei de Israel: Tomai a Micaías, e tornai a levá-lo a Amom, o governador da cidade, e a Joás, filho do rei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ λάβετε τὸν Μιχαιαν καὶ ἀποστρέψατε πρὸς Εμηρ ἄρχοντα τῆς πόλεως καὶ πρὸς Ιωας ἄρχοντα υἱὸν τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: and say: Thus says the king: Put this fellow in prison, and give him bread and water in a small quantity till I return in peace.
text_la: Et dicetis : Hæc dicit rex : Mittite hunc in carcerem, et date ei panis modicum, et aquæ pauxillum, donec revertar in pace.
text_pt: E direis: Assim diz o rei: Colocai este homem na casa do cárcere; e sustentai-o com pão de angústia, e com água de angústia, até que eu volte em paz.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖς οὕτως εἶπεν ὁ βασιλεύς ἀπόθεσθε τοῦτον εἰς οἶκον φυλακῆς καὶ ἐσθιέτω ἄρτον θλίψεως καὶ ὕδωρ θλίψεως ἕως τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι με ἐν εἰρήνῃ

text_en: And Micah said: If you return in peace, the Lord has not spoken by me. And he said: Hear, all you people.
text_la: Dixitque Michæas : Si reversus fueris in pace, non est locutus Dominus in me. Et ait : Audite, omnes populi.
text_pt: E disse Micaías: Se voltares em paz, o Senhor não tem falado por mim. Disse mais: Ouvi, povos todos!
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Μιχαιας ἐὰν ἐπιστρέφων ἐπιστρέψῃς ἐν εἰρήνῃ οὐκ ἐλάλησεν κύριος ἐν ἐμοί ἀκούσατε λαοὶ πάντες

text_en: So the king of Israel and Josaphat king of Juda went up to Ramoth Galaad.
text_la: Igitur ascenderunt rex Israël et Josaphat rex Juda in Ramoth Galaad.
text_pt: Subiram, pois, o rei de Israel e Jeosafá, rei de Judá, a Ramote de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα εἰς Ραμωθ Γαλααδ

text_en: And the king of Israel said to Josaphat: I will change my dress, and so I will go to the battle, but put on your own garments. And the king of Israel having changed his dress, went to the battle.
text_la: Dixitque rex Israël ad Josaphat : Mutabo habitum, et sic ad pugnam vadam : tu autem induere vestibus tuis. Mutatoque rex Israël habitu, venit ad bellum.
text_pt: E disse o rei de Israel a Jeosafá: Disfarçando-me eu, então entrarei na peleja; tu, porém, veste as tuas roupas reais. Disfarçou-se, pois, o rei de Israel, e entraram na peleja.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσαφατ κατακαλύψομαι καὶ εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς τὸν πόλεμον καὶ σὺ ἔνδυσαι τὸν ἱματισμόν μου καὶ συνεκαλύψατο βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς τὸν πόλεμον

text_en: Now the king of Syria had commanded the captains of his cavalry, saying: Fight not with small, or great, but with the king of Israel only.
text_la: Rex autem Syriæ præceperat ducibus equitatus sui, dicens : Ne pugnetis contra minimum aut contra maximum, nisi contra solum regem Israël.
text_pt: Deu ordem, porém, o rei da Síria aos capitães dos carros que tinha, dizendo: Não pelejareis nem contra pequeno, nem contra grande; senão só contra o rei de Israel.
text_el: καὶ βασιλεὺς Συρίας ἐνετείλατο τοῖς ἄρχουσιν τῶν ἁρμάτων τοῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ λέγων μὴ πολεμεῖτε τὸν μικρὸν καὶ τὸν μέγαν ἀλλ' ἢ τὸν βασιλέα Ισραηλ μόνον

text_en: So when the captains of the cavalry saw Josaphat, they said: This is the king of Israel . And they surrounded him to attack him: but he cried to the Lord , and he helped him, and turned them away from him.
text_la: Itaque cum vidissent principes equitatus Josaphat, dixerunt : Rex Israël est iste. Et circumdederunt eum dimicantes : at ille clamavit ad Dominum, et auxiliatus est ei, atque avertit eos ab illo.
text_pt: Sucedeu que, vendo os capitães dos carros a Jeosafá, disseram: Este é o rei de Israel, e o cercaram para pelejar; porém Jeosafá clamou, e o Senhor o ajudou. E Deus os desviou dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδον οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁρμάτων τὸν Ιωσαφατ καὶ αὐτοὶ εἶπαν Βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ἐστίν καὶ ἐκύκλωσαν αὐτὸν τοῦ πολεμεῖν καὶ ἐβόησεν Ιωσαφατ καὶ κύριος ἔσωσεν αὐτόν καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: For when the captains of the cavalry saw, that he was not the king of Israel , they left him.
text_la: Cum enim vidissent duces equitatus quod non esset rex Israël, reliquerunt eum.
text_pt: Porque sucedeu que, vendo os capitães dos carros, que não era o rei de Israel, deixaram de segui-lo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδον οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν ἁρμάτων ὅτι οὐκ ἦν βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἀπέστρεψαν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it happened that one of the people shot an arrow at a venture, and struck the king of Israel between the neck and the shoulders, and he said to his chariot man : Turn your hand, and carry me out of the battle, for I am wounded.
text_la: Accidit autem ut unus e populo sagittam in incertum jaceret, et percuteret regem Israël inter cervicem et scapulas. At ille aurigæ suo ait : Converte manum tuam, et educ me de acie, quia vulneratus sum.
text_pt: Então um homem armou o arco e atirou a esmo, e feriu o rei de Israel entre as junturas e a couraça; então disse ao carreteiro: Dá volta, e tira-me do exército, porque estou gravemente ferido.
text_el: καὶ ἀνὴρ ἐνέτεινεν τόξον εὐστόχως καὶ ἐπάταξεν τὸν βασιλέα Ισραηλ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ πνεύμονος καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ θώρακος καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἡνιόχῳ ἐπίστρεφε τὴν χεῖρά σου καὶ ἐξάγαγέ με ἐκ τοῦ πολέμου ὅτι ἐπόνεσα

text_en: And the fight was ended that day: but the king of Israel stood in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening, and died at the sunset.
text_la: Et finita est pugna in die illo : porro rex Israël stabat in curru suo contra Syros usque ad vesperam, et mortuus est occidente sole.
text_pt: E aquele dia cresceu a peleja, mas o rei de Israel susteve-se em pé no carro defronte dos sírios até à tarde; e morreu ao tempo do pôr do sol.
text_el: καὶ ἐτροπώθη ὁ πόλεμος ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ ὁ βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ ἦν ἑστηκὼς ἐπὶ τοῦ ἅρματος ἕως ἑσπέρας ἐξ ἐναντίας Συρίας καὶ ἀπέθανεν δύνοντος τοῦ ἡλίου

text_en: And Josaphat king of Juda returned to his house in peace to Jerusalem .
text_la: Reversus est autem Josaphat rex Juda in domum suam pacifice in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E Jeosafá, rei de Judá, voltou em paz à sua casa em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ιωσαφατ βασιλεὺς Ιουδα εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ ἐν εἰρήνῃ εἰς Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And Jehu the son of Hanani the seer met him, and said to him: You help the ungodly, and you are joined in friendship with them that hate the Lord , and therefore you deserved indeed the wrath of the Lord :
text_la: Cui occurrit Jehu filius Henani videns, et ait ad eum : Impio præbes auxilium, et his qui oderunt Dominum amicitia jungeris, et idcirco iram quidem Domini merebaris:
